text:
Asking rents in Aachen stand at a median of 11.57 €/m² (2026-06), up 2.6% on the year and +24.1% over five years. That ranks Aachen #18 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 61% above the 2022 average contract rent of 7.20 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 694 € a month in cold rent, 16.3% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 26 days and 26% are gone within a week; with 1.7% market-active vacancy and +1.6% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 12.28 €/m² (+6.1%), with an 80% range of 11.90 to 12.59 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
